title: Drumline, Newmarket On Fergus, Clare, V14V027
seoTitle: Drumline, Newmarket On Fergus, Clare, V14V027
description:
Sherry FitzGerald O’Donovan are delighted to bring to the market this exceptional five-bedroom detached residence, ideally situated in the highly sought-after area of Drumline, Newmarket-on-Fergus.

Set on approximately 1.3 acres of beautifully maintained grounds, this impressive home extends to approximately 277 sq. m. and offers generous and well-proportioned accommodation throughout. Presented in excellent condition and ready for immediate occupation, the property combines substantial living space with immaculate gardens and a peaceful countryside setting.

On entering the property, the ground floor comprises a welcoming entrance hall, spacious main living room, large double bedroom, open-plan kitchen and dining area, utility room and guest WC. The kitchen and dining area provides an excellent space for everyday family life and entertaining, while the separate living room offers a comfortable space to relax.

Upstairs, there are four further double bedrooms, including one with its own ensuite, along with the main family bathroom. In total, the property benefits from four bathrooms/WCs, providing excellent convenience for a busy household.

The attic has been converted to provide a generous additional storage area and also benefits from its own WC. The attic space is suitable for storage purposes only and is not presented as residential accommodation.

Outside, the property is equally impressive. The gardens have been meticulously maintained and provide a wonderful sense of space and privacy, with approximately 1.3 acres surrounding the residence. A pond adds to the character of the grounds, while the property also benefits from its own garage and a separate cabin. The cabin is not suitable for residential use but provides useful additional space for storage or a variety of other purposes.

The property also benefits from an impressive B energy rating, adding to its appeal and complementing the high standard of presentation throughout.

Drumline is a highly sought-after residential area, offering the peace and privacy of a rural setting while remaining within easy reach of Newmarket-on-Fergus and its excellent range of local amenities. The village provides shops, schools, sporting facilities, restaurants and other services, while the property is also conveniently located for access to Shannon, Ennis and Limerick. Shannon Airport and the wider road network are also within easy reach.

With approximately 277 sq. m. of accommodation, five double bedrooms, four bathrooms/WCs and 1.3 acres of beautifully maintained grounds, this is a substantial family home offering excellent space both inside and out.

Viewing is highly recommended to fully appreciate the quality, accommodation and setting this impressive property has to offer.
